Any protocol failure shuts down the endpoint and rejects all later operations.
Real Linux tests cover positive exchange plus root/seed/proof/tamper/replay/order/reflection/oversize/terminal failures.
No process, exec, production secret, network, probe, route, activation, market, usage, settlement, chain submission, or deployment occurs.
